title: Chain of Operators: An Inference-Time Harness for In-Context Operator Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.12318v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While scientific foundation models show immense promise in accelerating physical simulations and numerical forecasting, they remain notoriously brittle when encountering out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios. Adapting these generalist models to complex OOD tasks typically requires expensive parameter fine-tuning. In linguistic AI, this bottleneck is bypassed using "harnesses", which serve as external scaffolding such as reasoning chains and tool use to adapt frozen weights to complex tasks, yet designing an equivalent harness for physical domains remains an open frontier. To bridge this gap, we introduce Chain of Operators (CHOP), a framework that guides a frozen foundation model through complex OOD tasks without updating a single weight. translated_title: 算子链：一种用于上下文算子学习的推理时辅助框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.12318v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：尽管科学基础模型在加速物理模拟和数值预测方面展现出巨大潜力，但它们在面对分布外（OOD）场景时仍然非常脆弱。将这些通用模型适应于复杂的OOD任务通常需要昂贵的参数微调。在语言AI中，这一瓶颈通过使用“辅助框架”（harnesses）来绕过，这些框架作为外部脚手架，如推理链和工具使用，将冻结的权重适应于复杂任务，然而为物理领域设计等效的辅助框架仍是一个开放的前沿问题。为弥合这一差距，我们引入了算子链（CHOP），这是一个框架，它引导冻结的基础模型通过复杂的OOD任务而无需更新任何权重。通过利用上下文算子网络（ICON）的上下文学习能力，CHOP系统性地将不熟悉的问题分解为一系列显式、闭式的数学算子。
tldr: 本文提出算子链（CHOP）框架，利用冻结基础模型的上下文学习能力，将复杂分布外任务分解为闭式数学算子序列，实现无需参数更新的推理时适应。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Chain of Operators (CHOP), a framework that leverages the in-context learning ability of frozen foundation models to decompose complex out-of-distribution tasks into sequences of closed-form mathematical operators, enabling inference-time adaptation without parameter updates.
